name: lean
description: Fewer tokens at the same quality: a lean working skill, trimmed shell output, search agents on cheaper models, a test guard, check and code tools.

readGuard.title: Read guard
readGuard.description: Refuse a whole-file Read of a file over 400 lines once, pointing to Grep and a range; the same Read again goes through

testGuard.title: Test guard
testGuard.description: Refuse a full test-suite run once when the last full run in this repo was green and at most 15 files changed since, naming those files and their tests; the same command again goes through

checkTool.title: Check tool
checkTool.description: A check tool that runs lint, typecheck and the tests of the changed files in one call and prints only failures; its description rides every request

codeTool.title: Code tool
codeTool.description: A code tool that answers with a file's outline, one definition's source, a name's references or a repo map instead of whole files; its description rides every request

formatOnEdit.title: Format after edit
formatOnEdit.description: After an Edit or Write, run the repo's own ruff format or prettier on the file, only where the repo configures it

agentModel.title: Model for search agents
agentModel.description: What general-purpose and Explore agents run on when the call names no model; inherit keeps the session's model

sideSessionModel.title: Model for side sessions
sideSessionModel.description: Model id a new side session starts on when the call names none; inherit keeps the session's model
